note: Comments live in WordprocessingCommentsPart. Anchor: CommentRangeStart/End surround the target run or paragraph; CommentReference marks the inline anchor. Comment p/r paths support get, path-scoped set, add paragraph/run and remove paragraph/run. Global paragraph/run selectors also include matching comment-body nodes and return stable comment paths. Use raw /commentsExtended (or word/commentsExtended.xml) to preserve modern reply/resolved metadata.

id.description: OOXML comment id (w:comment/@w:id). Assigned by the writer; surfaces only on Get/Query.

anchoredTo.description: path of the paragraph or run the comment is anchored to (resolved from CommentRangeStart).

runStart.description: 1-based run index inside the parent paragraph where the comment range starts. N=0 (default) anchors the comment to paragraph start; N>=1 places <w:commentRangeStart/> immediately after the Nth run so dump→batch round-trip restores intra-paragraph anchor positions.
runStart.readback: n/a (encoded inline; surfaces via anchoredTo path)

range.description: Whether the comment spans a range (default true). Pass range=false or pointRef=true for a zero-width reference-only comment; range=none creates only the comment definition for raw/dump replay.

parentId.description: w:id of the comment this one replies to. Stored as w15:paraIdParent in word/commentsExtended.xml.

done.description: Resolved state, stored as w15:done in word/commentsExtended.xml.
